# QtKeychain 0.17.0 vendored from https://github.com/frankosterfeld/qtkeychain
# See COPYING for the upstream license. The upstream build system (ECM,
# translations, tests and installation rules) is intentionally not included.
#
# This is a static library linked into the app; no additional runtime library
# needs to be deployed. QTKEYCHAIN_NO_EXPORT avoids a generated export header.

find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core)

set(QTKEYCHAIN_SOURCES
    qtkeychain/keychain.cpp
    qtkeychain/keychain.h
    qtkeychain/keychain_p.h)
set(QTKEYCHAIN_LIBRARIES Qt6::Core)
set(QTKEYCHAIN_PRIVATE_DEFINITIONS)

if(WIN32)
    list(APPEND QTKEYCHAIN_SOURCES qtkeychain/keychain_win.cpp)
    list(APPEND QTKEYCHAIN_PRIVATE_DEFINITIONS USE_CREDENTIAL_STORE UNICODE)
    list(APPEND QTKEYCHAIN_LIBRARIES crypt32)
elseif(APPLE)
    enable_language(OBJCXX)
    list(APPEND QTKEYCHAIN_SOURCES qtkeychain/keychain_apple.mm)
    list(APPEND QTKEYCHAIN_LIBRARIES "-framework Foundation" "-framework Security")
elseif(UNIX AND NOT ANDROID AND NOT HAIKU AND NOT EMSCRIPTEN)
    find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS DBus)
    list(APPEND QTKEYCHAIN_LIBRARIES Qt6::DBus)
    list(APPEND QTKEYCHAIN_SOURCES
        qtkeychain/keychain_unix.cpp
        qtkeychain/gnomekeyring.cpp
        qtkeychain/gnomekeyring_p.h
        qtkeychain/libsecret.cpp
        qtkeychain/libsecret_p.h
        qtkeychain/plaintextstore.cpp
        qtkeychain/plaintextstore_p.h)
    list(APPEND QTKEYCHAIN_PRIVATE_DEFINITIONS KEYCHAIN_DBUS)

    # Secret Service is the secure backend on GNOME and most Linux desktops.
    option(QTKEYCHAIN_LIBSECRET "Enable QtKeychain's libsecret backend" ON)
    if(QTKEYCHAIN_LIBSECRET)
        find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
        pkg_check_modules(LIBSECRET REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET libsecret-1)
        list(APPEND QTKEYCHAIN_SOURCES qtkeychain/libsecret.cpp)
        list(APPEND QTKEYCHAIN_PRIVATE_DEFINITIONS HAVE_LIBSECRET)
        list(APPEND QTKEYCHAIN_LIBRARIES PkgConfig::LIBSECRET)
    endif()

    # KWallet's DBus interface is generated by Qt's DBus code generator.
    qt6_add_dbus_interface(QTKEYCHAIN_SOURCES
        qtkeychain/org.kde.KWallet.xml
        kwallet_interface)
else()
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Vendored QtKeychain supports Windows, macOS and Linux desktop only")
endif()

# Avoid duplicate source registration if libsecret was added above.
list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES QTKEYCHAIN_SOURCES)

add_library(qt6keychain STATIC ${QTKEYCHAIN_SOURCES})
set_target_properties(qt6keychain PROPERTIES AUTOMOC ON)
add_library(QtKeychain::QtKeychain ALIAS qt6keychain)
target_compile_features(qt6keychain PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_compile_definitions(qt6keychain
    PUBLIC QTKEYCHAIN_NO_EXPORT
    PRIVATE ${QTKEYCHAIN_PRIVATE_DEFINITIONS})
target_include_directories(qt6keychain
    PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR})
target_link_libraries(qt6keychain PUBLIC ${QTKEYCHAIN_LIBRARIES})

if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(qt6keychain PRIVATE /utf-8)
endif()
